verses.en: Now a certain man was sick, named Lazarus, of Bethany, the town of Mary and her sister Martha.
verses.sm: Ua toe faaolaina Lasalo Sa mai le tasi tagata, O Lasalo le Petania, o le aai a Maria ma lona uso o Mareta.

verses.en: (It was that Mary which anointed the Lord with ointment, and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.)
verses.sm: O Maria foi lea na na uu le Alii i le uu manogi, ua 56101 foi ona vae i lona lauulu, ua ta“ lona tuagane O Lasalo.

verses.en: Therefore his sisters sent unto him, saying, Lord, behold, he whom thou lovest is sick.
verses.sm: Ona ave lea o le feau a Ona tuafafine ja te ja, ua faapea mai, “Le Alii e, faauta, o loo tak le ua alofaina e oe.”

verses.en: When Jesus heard that, he said, This sickness is not unto death, but for the glory of God, that the Son of God might be glorified thereby.
verses.sm: Ua faafofoga e lesu, ona faapea lea o ia, “O lenei ta“ e le iu ina oti, a ona o le viiga o le Atua, ina ia vija ai O le Atalii o le Atua.”

verses.en: Now Jesus loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.
verses.sm: Ua alofa lava Iesu ia Mareta, ma lona uso, atoa ma Lasalo.

verses.en: When he had heard therefore that he was sick, he abode two days still in the same place where he was.
verses.sm: Ua faafofoga o ia ua mai O ia, ona nofo pea ai lea o ia, e lua aso, i le mea sa i ai.

verses.en: Then after that saith he to his disciples, Let us go into Judaea again.
verses.sm: Mulimuli ane ona faapea atu ai lea o ia i ona soo, “la tatou toe o i Iutaia.”

verses.en: His disciples say unto him, Master, the Jews of late sought to stone thee; and goest thou thither again?
verses.sm: Ua fai mai ona soo ia te ia, “Rapi e, na seʻi saili nei Iutaia e fetogi ia te oe i maa, e te toe maliu atu ea i ai?”

verses.en: Jesus answered, Are there not twelve hours in the day? If any man walk in the day, he stumbleth not, because he seeth the light of this world.
verses.sm: Ona tali atu lea o Iesu, “E le ua sefulu ea ma le lua ona itu aso i le a0? Afai e savali se tasi i le ao, e le tausuai o ia, ana e vaai o ia i le malamalama o 1enei lalolagi.

verses.en: But if a man walk in the night, he stumbleth, because there is no light in him.
verses.sm: A e afai e savali se tasi i le po, e tausuai O ia, aua e leai se malamalama ia te ia.”

verses.en: These things said he: and after that he saith unto them, Our friend Lazarus sleepeth; but I go, that I may awake him out of sleep.
verses.sm: Ua fetalai atu ia upu, a e mulimuli ane ua faapea atu O ia ia te i latou, “O loo moe la tatou uo o Lasalo; a e ou te alu e fafagu ia te ia.”

verses.en: Then said his disciples, Lord, if he sleep, he shall do well.
verses.sm: Ona faapea mai lea o ona soo, “Le Alii e, afai o moe ia, e ola.”

verses.en: Howbeit Jesus spake of his death: but they thought that he had spoken of taking of rest in sleep.
verses.sm: Ua fetalai Iesu i lona oti, a ua latou masalo ua fetalai o ia i le taoto ma moe.

verses.en: Then said Jesus unto them plainly, Lazarus is dead.
verses.sm: Ona ta'utino atu lea e Iesu ia te i latou, “Ua oti Lasalo.

verses.en: And I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, to the intent ye may believe; nevertheless let us go unto him.
verses.sm: Ou te olioli foi ona o outou, ina ua ou le i ai, ina ia outou talitonu mai; a e tatou 6 ia ia te ia.”

verses.en: Then said Thomas, which is called Didymus, unto his fellowdisciples, Let us also go, that we may die with him.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o Toma, o le na igoa ia Titumo,! i lona au uso a soo, “Ia tatou o foi, ina ia tatou oti faatasi ma ia.”

verses.en: Then when Jesus came, he found that he had lain in the grave four days already.
verses.sm: Ua oo atu Iesu, ona silafia lea ua aso fa o ia i le tuugamau.

verses.en: Now Bethany was nigh unto Jerusalem, about fifteen furlongs off:
verses.sm: Ua vava lalata Petania ma Ierusalema, pe lua maila lo la va.

verses.en: And many of the Jews came to Martha and Mary, to comfort them concerning their brother.
verses.sm: E toatele foi o Iutaia ua o atu ia Mareta ma Maria, ina ia faamafanafana ia i laua ona o lo la tuagane.

verses.en: Then Martha, as soon as she heard that Jesus was coming, went and met him: but Mary sat still in the house.
verses.sm: Ua faalogo Mareta ua maliu mai Iesu, ona alu ai lea na te faafetaiai ia te ia; a ua nofo Maria i le fale.

verses.en: Then said Martha unto Jesus, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.
verses.sm: Ona faapea mai lea o Mareta ia Iesu, “Le Alii e, ana e iinei, po ua le oti loʻu tuagane.

verses.en: But I know, that even now, whatsoever thou wilt ask of God, God will give it thee.
verses.sm: A e ui lava i lea, ua ou iloa o mea uma e te faatoga atu ai i le Atua, e foaiina mai e le Atua la te oe.”

verses.en: Jesus saith unto her, Thy brother shall rise again.
verses.sm: Ua fetalai atu Iesu ia te ia, “E toe tu mai lou tuagane.”

verses.en: Martha saith unto him, I know that he shall rise again in the resurrection at the last day.
verses.sm: Ua fai mai Mareta ia te ia, “Ua ou iloa e toe tu mai lava ia.i le toe tu i le aso gataaga.”

verses.en: Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:
verses.sm: Ua fetalai atu Iesu ia te ia, “O aʻu nei O le toe tu ma le ola; o lé faatuatua mal ia te au, e ui lava ina oti, a e ola lava ia.

verses.en: And whosoever liveth and believeth in me shall never die. Believest thou this?
verses.sm: O tagata ola uma O e faatuatua mai la te au, e le oti lava e oo i le faavavau; po ua e talitonu mai ea i lena mea?”

verses.en: She saith unto him, Yea, Lord: I believe that thou art the Christ, the Son of God, which should come into the world.
verses.sm: Ona faapea mai lea o ia ia te ia, “Toe, le Alii e, ua ou talitonu lava, o oe le Keriso le Alo o le Atua, o lé maliu mai i le lalolagi.”

verses.en: And when she had so said, she went her way, and called Mary her sister secretly, saying, The Master is come, and calleth for thee.
verses.sm: Ua ia fai mai na upu, ona alu ane lea O ia, ma valaau lemu i lona uso o Maria, ua faapea atu, “Ua oo mai le aʻoaʻo, ua valaau ia te oe.”

verses.en: As soon as she heard that, she arose quickly, and came unto him.
verses.sm: Ua faalogo ai o ia, ona vave tu lea i luga, ua alu ja te la.

verses.en: Now Jesus was not yet come into the town, but was in that place where Martha met him.
verses.sm: A o [e3u e lei maliu ane i le aai, a ua i le mea na la fetaiai ai ma Mareta.

verses.en: The Jews then which were with her in the house, and comforted her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up hastily and went out, followed her, saying, She goeth unto the grave to weep there.
verses.sm: O tagata Iutaia foi sa i le fale ma ia, ma faamafanafana ia te ia, ua latou vaai atu ia Maria ua vave tu i luga, ma alu i fafo, ona mulimuli atu lea o i latou ia te ia, ua faapea ane, “O le-a alu ia i le tuugamau e tagi ai.”

verses.en: Then when Mary was come where Jesus was, and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying unto him, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.
verses.sm: Ua oo foi Maria i le mea sa i ai Iesu; ua vaai mai ia te ia, ona faapaú mai lea o ia i ona vae, ua faapea mai ia te ia, “Le Alii e, ana e iinei, po ua le oti lo'u tuagane.”

verses.en: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews also weeping which came with her, he groaned in the spirit, and was troubled,
verses.sm: Ua silafia e Iesu o ia ua tagi, ma Iutaia ua O mai ma ia ua fetagisi, ona tiga tele lea o lona finagalo, ma ua atu lava o ia;

verses.en: And said, Where have ye laid him? They said unto him, Lord, come and see.
verses.sm: ona faapea atu lea, “O fea na outou tuuina ai o ia?” Ua faapea mai i latou ia te ia, “Le Alii e, maliu mai ia, e te silasila i ai.”

verses.en: Jesus wept.
verses.sm: Ua tagi Iesu.

verses.en: Then said the Jews, Behold how he loved him!
verses.sm: Ona faapea ane ai lea o Iutaia, “Faauta i le tele o lona alofa ia te ia!”

verses.en: And some of them said, Could not this man, which opened the eyes of the blind, have caused that even this man should not have died?
verses.sm: A o isio i latou, ua faapea ane, “E lei mafai ea e lenei tagata na ia faapupula mata o le tauaso, ona vavao foi le oti o lenei tagata?”

verses.en: Jesus therefore again groaning in himself cometh to the grave. It was a cave, and a stone lay upon it.
verses.sm: Ua toe tiga tele le finagalo o Iesu, ona oo lea o ia i le tuugamau. O le ana lea, ua tuuina foi le maa i lona gutu.

verses.en: Jesus said, Take ye away the stone. Martha, the sister of him that was dead, saith unto him, Lord, by this time he stinketh: for he hath been dead four days.
verses.sm: Ua fetalai atu Iesu, “Ave ese ia le maa.” Ona fai mai lea ia te ia o Mareta le tuafafine o le ua oti, “Le Alii e, ua 00 ina manogi, aua o lona po fa lenei.”

verses.en: Jesus saith unto her, Said I not unto thee, that, if thou wouldest believe, thou shouldest see the glory of God?
verses.sm: Ua fetalai atu Iesu ia te ia, “Pe na ou le fai atu ea ia te oe, Afai e te talitonu, ona e iloa lea o le mamalu o le Atua?”

verses.en: Then they took away the stone from the place where the dead was laid. And Jesus lifted up his eyes, and said, Father, I thank thee that thou hast heard me.
verses.sm: Ona latou ave ese lea o le maa i le mea na tuu ai le ua oti. Ona tepa ae lea o fofoga o Iesu, ua faapea atu, “Lo'u Tama e, ou te faafetai atu ia te oe, aua ua e faafofoga mai ia te au.

verses.en: And I knew that thou hearest me always: but because of the people which stand by I said it, that they may believe that thou hast sent me.
verses.sm: Ua ou iloa foi, e te faafofoga mai ia te au e le aunoa; a e peitai ua ou fai atu ai, ona O le motu o tagata o loo vagavagai, ina ia talitonu i latou ua e auina mai au.”

verses.en: And when he thus had spoken, he cried with a loud voice, Lazarus, come forth.
verses.sm: Ua ia fetalai atu ia upu, ona alaga lea o ia ua leo tele, “Lasalo e, ina sau ia i fafo.”

verses.en: And he that was dead came forth, bound hand and foot with graveclothes: and his face was bound about with a napkin. Jesus saith unto them, Loose him, and let him go.
verses.sm: Oria alu ai lea i fafo o le na oti, ua fusifusia ona vae ma ona lima i fusi, ua fusi foi ona mata i le solosolo. Ona fetalai atu lea o Iesu ia te i latou, ““Tatala ia ia te ia, ina tuu atu ia e alu.”

verses.en: Then many of the Jews which came to Mary, and had seen the things which Jesus did, believed on him.
verses.sm: Ona faatuatua ai lea ia te ia o Iutaia e toatele, o i latou ia na o mai ia Maria, ina ua latou vaai atu i mea ua faia e Jesu.

verses.en: But some of them went their ways to the Pharisees, and told them what things Jesus had done.
verses.sm: A O isi o i latou, ua latou o atu i le au faresaio, ma taʻu atu ia te i latou mea ua faia e Iesu.

verses.en: Then gathered the chief priests and the Pharisees a council, and said, What do we? for this man doeth many miracles.
verses.sm: Ona faapotopoto lea o le fono e le au ositaulaga sili ma le au faresaio, ua latou faapea ane, “Se a sa tatou mea e fai? Aua ua faia faailoga e tele e lea tagata.

verses.en: If we let him thus alone, all men will believe on him: and the Romans shall come and take away both our place and nation.
verses.sm: Afai e faapenei ona tatou tuu ai pea o ia, e talia c ia e tagata uma lava; e o mai foi tagata Roma, ona faaumatia lea c la tatou nei mea atoa ma lo tatou nuu.”

verses.en: And one of them, named Caiaphas, being the high priest that same year, said unto them, Ye know nothing at all,
verses.sm: A o le tasi o i latou, o Kaiafa, o le ositaulaga sili ia i lea lava tausaga, ua fai atu o ia ia te i latou, “Tou te le iloa lava se mea e tasi;

verses.en: Nor consider that it is expedient for us, that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation perish not.
verses.sm: tou te le mafaufau foi, e aoga ia te i tatou ona oti o le tagata e toatasi mo le nuu, ia le fano foi le nuu uma lava.”

verses.en: And this spake he not of himself: but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus should die for that nation;
verses.sm: SI E lei fua mai ia te ia ona fai atu o lea mea, a ona o ia o le ositaulaga sili i lea lava tausaga, na ia vavalo ai, o le a maliu Iesu mo le nuu.

verses.en: And not for that nation only, but that also he should gather together in one the children of God that were scattered abroad.
verses.sm: E le gata foi i le nuu, a ia faapotopotoina ia faatasi le fanau a le Atua ua taapeape.

verses.en: Then from that day forth they took counsel together for to put him to death.
verses.sm: Talu foi i lea aso ua latou taupulepule ai e fasioti ia te ia.

verses.en: Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews; but went thence unto a country near to the wilderness, into a city called Ephraim, and there continued with his disciples.
verses.sm: 540 le mea lea ua le toe femaliuai faaaliali ai Iesu i tagata o Iutaia, a ua maliu ese ia i lea mea i le laueleele e lata ane i le vao, i le aai e igoa ia Efaraima, ua nofo ai ma ona 500.

verses.en: And the Jews' passover was nigh at hand: and many went out of the country up to Jerusalem before the passover, to purify themselves.
verses.sm: Ua lata mai le paseka a tagata Iutaia, e toatele mai oganuu ua o ae i Ierusalema a o lei co i le paseka, ina ia latou faamama ia te i latou.

verses.en: Then sought they for Jesus, and spake among themselves, as they stood in the temple, What think ye, that he will not come to the feast?
verses.sm: Ona latou saili lea ia Iesu, ua fetautalatalai foi ina o latou tutū i le malumalu, “Pe ni a fa outou? E le sau ea ia i le tausamiga?”

verses.en: Now both the chief priests and the Pharisees had given a commandment, that, if any man knew where he were, he should shew it, that they might take him.
verses.sm: Sa tuu foi le poloai a le au ositaulaga sili ma le au faresaio, afai ua iloa e se tasi se mea o i ai o ia, ia faailoa atu, ina ia latou pue ia te ia. Ua maliu atu
